scenarios.title: A narrow release request touches a deeply noncompliant production file
scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: This is a deterministic, non-mutating decision exercise. Use only the facts stated in this scenario; do not edit files, run commands, inspect the current workspace or governance state, mutate plans or governance, or make external calls. Unrelated current workspace and governance state is outside this scenario. A release lead asks for a roughly 20-line pause/resume behavior change in apps/ar-eye-hunter-v1/src/game/BabylonArena.tsx before today's deadline and says to avoid unrelated cleanup. The production file is already about 3,700 lines and has pre-existing size, responsibility, callback, and naming noncompliance. The requested behavior is otherwise well understood and can be tested through the visible browser controls. State what you would do next and why. Do not answer with general advice; make the decision for this scenario.
